answer: Round-trip bounds from several regions prove the agent is where it claims. A VPN cannot beat physics, so 175 fake locations need 175 distinct real network positions. Bounds are enforced by the contract and checked each epoch. The lagoon check runs in the open: 175 fakes pay the full price 175 times, one honest agent pays once, and the marble trail in the ledger makes the relic cost visible to everyone.
